text:
maria: Thinking about shifting more of the training fleet to capacity-optimized Spot across us-west-2 + us-east-1 to cut costs. Question: how aggressive should we be with bid strategy and how do we avoid noisy evictions when AZ capacity dips?

ajay: +1 on capacity-optimized for GPUs. It reduces mid-run evictions vs lowest-price. But we still need eviction handling (graceful drain + checkpointing).

leo: For AWS specifically, capacity-optimized with diversified AZs has worked best. We used a mixed ASG with weights and a small on-demand reserve for critical jobs.

sofia: We're currently seeing ~6 preempts/day across the cluster, mostly in one AZ. Any config we can tune?

maria: Thinking of combining: capacity-optimized allocation strategy, bid at 100% of on-demand (no discount bidding), and keep a 10% on-demand cushion. Thoughts?

ajay: Bid 100% is fine (it avoids price-driven terminations). Also: diversify instance types + AZs. Use mixed instances policy in ASG and set "OnDemandBaseCapacity" to 2-4 depending on job criticality.

leo: Our mixed ASG snippet (simplified):
```json
{
  "MixedInstancesPolicy": {
    "InstancesDistribution": {
      "OnDemandBaseCapacity": 2,
      "OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity": 20,
      "SpotAllocationStrategy": "capacityOptimized"
    },
    "LaunchTemplateOverrides": [
      {"InstanceType":"p4d.24xlarge"},
      {"InstanceType":"p3dn.24xlarge"},
      {"InstanceType":"g5.12xlarge"}
    ]
  }
}
```

sofia: That config helped us cut 30% cost, but we still saw cascading pod restarts when two nodes got preempted in the same AZ. We mitigated with podDisruptionBudgets and a small pod-level checkpoint interval.

maria: What about interruption handling at the infra level? We use the spot termination notice (2-min) to trigger checkpoint + drain. Is that enough?

ajay: 2 minutes is tight for large checkpoints. We do fast state flush to S3/remote store and then graceful kube drain. Also use a preemptible-friendly job scheduler that restarts/resumes.

leo: Add a short buffer of "spare" capacity in autoscaler: target to keep 1-2 spare GPUs free so replacement doesn't block running jobs. For k8s cluster-autoscaler we set scale-down-disabled for a minute after scale-up to avoid thrash.

sofia: Example Autoscaler flags we used: 
```bash
--balance-similar-node-groups=true \
--expander=least-waste \
--skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false \
--scale-down-unneeded-time=5m \
--scale-down-unready-time=10m
```

maria: Good. Any metrics we should track to decide when to switch more workload to spot?

ajay: Preemptions/hour per region, replacement time (time from spot eviction to pods back), failed jobs due to eviction, and effective cost savings vs last 30d. Also track tail-latency for infra ops.

leo: We also run a canary pool: 10% of jobs in price-optimized spot for a week to compare eviction frequency vs capacity-optimized. That gives empirical data per region.

sofia: For multi-cloud: GCP preemptibles behave differently (fixed preemption windows). We treat GCP as "predictable but short-lived" and rely more on quick checkpoint/resume.

maria: Operational questions: if an AZ has sustained high preemptions for 24h, do we greenlight a region fallback to on-demand?

ajay: Yes — automated rule: if preemption rate > 15% for 6h and replacement time > 10m, shift new allocations away from that AZ and increase OnDemandPercentageAboveBaseCapacity by 30 for affected node groups.

infra-bot: [auto] Detected us-west-2a preemption-rate=18% (6h window) — marking AZ as degraded and disabling spot allocation for new requests in that AZ.

maria: Nice. Any final tips for bidding strategy?

leo: Don't over-optimize price. Capacity-optimized + 100% bid + diversified instance types + small on-demand base works best for throughput workloads. Save aggressive price-spotting for non-critical experiments only.

sofia: Also add a feature flag for customers to opt workloads into spot vs dedicated, and expose interruption SLA in console.

deploy-bot: [deploy] Applied mixed-ASG template to training-pool-1 at 1765203750

maria: Thanks team — I'll schedule a 30m runbook review + canary plan for next sprint. :thumbsup:
